services_heading: Garden Design & Landscaping Services Across Manchester
services_subhead: From initial concept to planting and maintenance, we handle every aspect of creating your dream garden.

services.title: Bespoke Garden Design
services.desc: Tailored garden plans that suit your space, style, and budget. We listen to your vision and create detailed designs before any work begins.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Expert planting of shrubs, perennials, and seasonal flowers. We choose plants suited to your soil and light conditions for long-term colour and structure.

services.title: Patio & Hardscaping
services.desc: Laying patios, pathways, and raised beds using quality materials. Creates functional outdoor living spaces that complement your garden design.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular pruning, weeding, and seasonal care to keep your garden thriving. We tailor visits to suit your garden's needs throughout the year.

services.title: Rose Gardens & Specialists Planting
services.desc: Create stunning rose gardens with expert varieties and placement. From climbing roses to heritage shrub varieties, we specialise in making roses thrive.

services.title: Garden Transformation Projects
services.desc: Complete garden overhauls for overgrown or neglected spaces. We clear, plan, and rebuild from the ground up, turning problem gardens into beautiful outdoor rooms.

about_pullquote: I create gardens people actually want to spend time in, not just look at.
about_para_1: Edens Rose Garden Design was born from a passion for creating beautiful, functional outdoor spaces across Manchester. With over 15 years' experience in horticulture and garden design, we've transformed hundreds of gardens — from small city courtyards to sprawling suburban plots. Every project starts with a conversation about what you want your garden to feel like, not just what it looks like.
about_para_2: We're known for listening carefully, delivering honest advice, and creating gardens that work with your lifestyle and the local Manchester climate. Our customers come back year after year because we're just as invested in their garden's long-term success as they are. We don't believe in quick fixes — we build gardens that mature beautifully and bring genuine joy.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: We had an overgrown mess at the back of our house in Didsbury. Sarah came round, listened to what we actually wanted, and transformed it into somewhere we genuinely enjoy spending time. The planting scheme is brilliant — colour from spring right through to autumn. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael P.

reviews.text: Had a rose garden I wanted to revive. Edens Rose knew exactly which varieties would thrive in our soil and aspect. The roses came in looking quite small but now, a year on, they're absolutely flourishing. Professional, friendly, and they actually care about getting it right.
reviews.author: Eleanor H.

reviews.text: Brilliant from start to finish. Free design consultation helped us visualise the space, and the team turned it around on time and on budget. Our garden went from depressing to something our whole family uses every weekend. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: James T.
